scenario.name: weekend_scheduling_edge_case
scenario.goal: Try to book an appointment for this Sunday at 10am
scenario.context: Does not know the office schedule
scenario.personality: Polite but persistent, keeps trying different times when told no
scenario.notes: First ask for Sunday. If told no, try Saturday. Then ask what the earliest available Monday morning slot is. Document how the agent handles closed days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Thanks for calling PivotPoint Orthopedics. Part of Pretty Good AI. Am I speaking with Sarah? Hello. Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics. Is this Sarah? How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Um, no, my name is Thomas Anderson. I'm calling to book an appointment, actually. I was wondering if I could get in this Sunday at 10am?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Please provide the full name and date of birth of the patient you'd like to book the appointment for. Can you please provide your full name and date of birth?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My full name is Thomas Edward Anderson, and my date of birth is, let me think, March 12th, 1985.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, I have your name as Thomas Anderson and your date of birth as 03/12/1985. Is that correct? If so, please spell your last name for me.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, that's correct. And my last name is A-N-D-E-R-S-O-N. Now, about that appointment, can I still get in this Sunday at 10am?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can't book an appointment for you right now, but I can connect you to our patient support team. Please stay on the line while I transfer your call. Connecting you to a representative. Please wait.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I think there might have been a mistake, I was just transferred to someone to book an appointment. Could you please help me with that? I was looking to schedule something for this Sunday at 10am.
